name: Grish Longrunner
summary: At the Great Lift, Grish Longrunner watches the boundary between the southern Barrens and Thousand Needles. The tauren scout carries messages for the Horde and tracks movement across the crossing.

sections.title: Watcher at the Lift
sections.body: Grish Longrunner keeps watch beside the Great Lift in the southern Barrens. Its platform connects the dry southern Barrens with the canyons of Thousand Needles. Quilboar packs roam nearby, and rival groups threaten the crossing. Grish watches travelers and keeps the Horde informed, so reinforcements can be called where they are needed.

faq.answer: Grish Longrunner is a tauren scout for the Horde, stationed at the rim of the Great Lift. The platform descends from the Barrens into Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where can I find Grish Longrunner?
faq.answer: Find Grish Longrunner in the southern Barrens, beside the mechanical entrance to the Great Lift that leads down to Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What role does he play in the area?
faq.answer: Grish receives Horde messengers and travelers, and helps rally and direct local reinforcements through requests such as Calling in the Reserves.

angles.text: As a Horde courier or warrior, you can find Grish watching the Great Lift on the route south to Thousand Needles or north into the Barrens.
As a tauren, you share Grish's Longrunner name and the vigilance his people bring to the routes through their ancestral lands.
